verdict.rationale: Motion's docs describe several autonomous background behaviors—auto-reshuffling calendars, auto-scheduling tasks from emails/voice, auto-advancing projects when blockers clear, and an 'AI Workflow Builder' that automatically builds workflows from SOPs—that run without direct user action each time. However, these are scoped to scheduling/task/project domains rather than a general-purpose automation/trigger framework, and there's no independent or hands-on evidence confirming these automations reliably run unattended at scale. Missing for 10: independent verification of autonomous execution reliability, evidence of a broader agentic automation builder with custom triggers/conditions beyond calendar and SOP workflows.
